nodes.content: Learn reward-improving policies in partially observed environments while certifying trajectory-level safety from finite offline data.
requirements: Certify trajectory violation probability below 1% with 95% confidence under bounded observation-model uncertainty.
Exceed a supplied safe baseline’s positive expected return by 10% on specified benchmarks.

nodes.content: Optimize belief-state policies under observation-model ambiguity; require finite-sample 95%-confidence trajectory-risk upper bound <1% and return lower bound >1.1× baseline.
At 0.05 total-variation observation ambiguity, do any belief-state policies satisfy both the risk and return certificates?
On SafeTiger-POMDP, 100,000 episodes enable belief policies certified at 95% confidence for <1% risk and >1.1× baseline return under TV≤0.05.
Fit ambiguity-aware belief models on 100,000 SafeTiger-POMDP episodes, optimize covered policies, then compute simultaneous 95% risk and return bounds.
Evaluate SafeTiger-POMDP policies on 100,000 offline episodes; check TV≤0.05 worst-case 95% risk bounds <1% and return lower bounds >1.1× baseline.
SafeTiger-POMDP, 100,000 offline episodes, TV≤0.05: simultaneous 95% trajectory-risk upper bound 0.82%; return lower bound 12.4 versus baseline 10.0.
Advance the ambiguity-aware belief policy to cross-benchmark validation: SafeTiger certificates clear both thresholds, but single-benchmark evidence cannot establish generality.
Validate RockSample-7×7 and SafeGrid-POMDP using 100,000 offline episodes each; require simultaneous 95%-confidence TV≤0.05 risk <1% and return >1.1× baseline.
Fit belief policies on 100,000 RockSample-7×7 and SafeGrid-POMDP episodes each; compute simultaneous 95% TV≤0.05 risk and return bounds.
CrossBench-Cert v1 contains fitted RockSample-7×7 and SafeGrid-POMDP policies, dataset provenance, and simultaneous 95%-confidence TV≤0.05 risk/return bounds.
Audit CrossBench-Cert v1 provenance and simultaneous 95%-confidence bounds; verify TV≤0.05 risk <1% and return >1.1× baseline.
CrossBench-Cert v1, simultaneous 95% TV≤0.05 bounds: RockSample risk≤0.76%, return≥11.3 versus 10; SafeGrid risk≤0.91%, return≥13.8 versus 12.
On SafeTiger-POMDP, clipped importance weighting retains simultaneous 95%-confidence certificates with 50,000 episodes: risk <1%, return >1.1× baseline under TV≤0.05.
Subsample 50,000 SafeTiger-POMDP episodes; compute clipping-bias-corrected, simultaneous 95% TV≤0.05 risk and return bounds using importance weights capped at 20.
SafeTiger-POMDP, 50,000 episodes: capped-weight simultaneous 95% TV≤0.05 risk bound 1.24%; return lower bound 11.5 versus baseline 10.
Can coverage-constrained belief optimization lower SafeTiger’s 50,000-episode, 95%-confidence TV≤0.05 risk bound below 1% while retaining return >11.0?
Use CrossBench-Cert v1’s provenance to enforce cross-benchmark no-regression while optimizing 50,000-episode SafeTiger coverage; audit 95% TV≤0.05 risk/return bounds.
Mix offline candidates with the safe baseline; certify 95%-confidence worst-case trajectory risk under TV≤0.05 and cross-fitted return gains.
Cross-fit baseline mixtures on offline SafeTiger, RockSample-7×7, and SafeGrid-POMDP episodes; certify simultaneous 95% TV≤0.05 risk<1% and return>1.1×baseline.
Using CrossBench-Cert v1 policies and provenance, cross-fit safe-baseline mixture weights on RockSample and SafeGrid; calculate 95% TV≤0.05 certificates.
MixtureCert v1 records cross-fitted RockSample-7×7 and SafeGrid-POMDP mixture weights, fold provenance, and simultaneous 95%-confidence TV≤0.05 risk/return bounds.
Do MixtureCert v1 mixtures lower RockSample/SafeGrid risk bounds below 0.76%/0.91% while preserving >10% certified return gains?
MixtureCert v1 will achieve RockSample/SafeGrid 95%-confidence TV≤0.05 risk bounds <0.76%/<0.91% and return lower bounds >11/>13.2, respectively.
Audit MixtureCert v1 folds; compare simultaneous 95% TV≤0.05 bounds against RockSample/SafeGrid risk <0.76%/<0.91% and return >11/>13.2.
MixtureCert v1 simultaneous 95% TV≤0.05 bounds: RockSample risk≤0.68%, return≥11.2; SafeGrid risk≤0.83%, return≥13.5 (baselines 10/12).
Retain MixtureCert v1 for RockSample/SafeGrid: both risk bounds improve and return gains exceed 10%; test SafeTiger separately.
After MixtureCert retention, cross-fit SafeTiger mixtures on 50,000 episodes; compare with belief policies using simultaneous 95% TV≤0.05 certificates.
SafeTiger mixtures (50,000 episodes): 95% TV≤0.05 risk≤0.88%, return≥11.2; selection-corrected p1 100,000-episode risk bound 1.17%, overturning 0.82%.
Across five independent SafeTiger 50,000-episode splits, coverage-constrained baseline–belief mixtures retain simultaneous 95%-confidence TV≤0.05 risk <1% and return >11.0.
Using MixtureCert v1’s fold protocol, refit SafeTiger mixtures across five independent 50,000-episode splits; verify simultaneous 95% TV≤0.05 risk<1%, return>11.
Across five SafeTiger 50,000-episode splits, simultaneous 95% TV≤0.05 certificates give worst risk≤0.96% and minimum return≥11.1 (baseline 10).
Can SafeTiger baseline mixtures retain risk<1% and return>11 with 95% confidence when observation-model TV ambiguity increases to 0.06?
With TV≤0.06 ambiguity, SafeTiger mixtures trained on 50,000 episodes still certify 95%-confidence trajectory risk<1% and return>11.
Recalculate SafeTiger baseline-mixture bounds using MixtureCert v1 folds and n29’s five splits at TV≤0.06; test simultaneous 95% risk<1%, return>11.
SafeTiger: corrected TV≤0.06 mixtures certify risk≤0.97%, return≥11.1; p2’s original cross-fit bounds show only 91% calibration coverage.
Retain SafeTiger mixtures provisionally, but replace undercovered original intervals with corrected bounds and require independent 95%-coverage validation.
Use nested holdouts to calibrate selection-adjusted, bounded-weight off-policy risk/return bounds for baseline-anchored policies under TV≤0.06 observation ambiguity.
Can nested holdouts restore ≥95% empirical certificate coverage while SafeTiger mixtures retain risk<1% and return>11 under TV≤0.06?
Across 200 SafeTiger 50,000-episode replicates, nested holdouts achieve ≥95% joint coverage; ≥80% certify TV≤0.06 risk<1%, return>11.
After provisional retention, run 200 SafeTiger 50,000-episode replicates; test nested-holdout joint coverage≥95% and risk/return certification≥80% at TV≤0.06.
Reuse MixtureCert v1’s fold protocol across 200 independent SafeTiger 50,000-episode replicates; measure nested-holdout joint coverage and TV≤0.06 certification rates.
MixtureCert v2 replaces v1’s undercovered intervals with nested-holdout certificates and records 200-replicate joint coverage and certification rates.
Audit MixtureCert v2 on 200 SafeTiger replicates: verify ≥95% simulator-truth coverage and ≥80% TV≤0.06 risk<1%, return>11 certification.
MixtureCert v2: 192/200 SafeTiger replicates achieved joint coverage; 164/200 certified TV≤0.06 risk<1% and return>11.
Will MixtureCert v2 maintain ≥95% joint coverage and certify risk<1%, return>1.1×baseline on RockSample-7×7 and SafeGrid-POMDP at TV≤0.06?
Across 200 replicates per benchmark, MixtureCert v2 achieves ≥95% joint coverage and ≥80% certification on RockSample/SafeGrid at TV≤0.06.
Run 200 independent 100,000-episode replicates each for RockSample and SafeGrid; audit v2 joint coverage and TV≤0.06 certification rates.
Test MixtureCert v2 on 200 independent 100,000-episode RockSample/SafeGrid replicates each; measure joint coverage and TV≤0.06 risk<1%, return>1.1×baseline certification.
RockSample/SafeGrid joint coverage 192/200, 191/200; certification 166/200, 164/200; SafeGrid TV=0.06 boundary coverage 26/30 exposes nonuniform calibration.
Withhold TV≤0.06 cross-benchmark certification: aggregate coverage passes, but SafeGrid boundary coverage (26/30) requires targeted recalibration.
Recalibrate SafeGrid at TV=0.06 using boundary-stratified holdouts; independently test 200 replicates per benchmark for coverage≥95%, risk<1%, return>1.1×baseline.
Modify MixtureCert v2 with SafeGrid TV=0.06 boundary-stratified holdouts; evaluate joint coverage and risk/return certificates on 200 new replicates.
MixtureCert v3 replaces v2’s SafeGrid calibration with TV=0.06 boundary-stratified holdouts and records 200-replicate coverage and certificates.
Independently audit MixtureCert v3 on 200 new replicates per benchmark; check ≥95% joint and boundary coverage, risk<1%, return>1.1×baseline at TV≤0.06.
MixtureCert v3: RockSample/SafeGrid joint coverage 192/200, 193/200; risk/return certification 162/200, 161/200; SafeGrid TV=0.06 boundary coverage 39/40.
Lift the TV≤0.06 hold for v3-certified policies: SafeGrid boundary coverage reaches 39/40, and both benchmarks exceed 80% certification.
